title: One tag in your journal can expose your worst habit

channel.name: Andrew Builds (TradeNotes)
channel.appBlurb: a trading journal and performance analytics app

body.hook: One tag in your journal can expose your worst habit.
body.promise: Watch ten sample trades. The pattern is not in the wins or the losses.

beats.narration: At first it looks random. Wins, losses, nothing that stands out.
Now add one tag to every trade: was it taken right after a loss?
In this sample, the trades taken right after a loss do most of the damage. Same trader, same setup.

scene.title: Split by tag
scene.note: 10 SAMPLE trades, not real results. Far too few to conclude anything.

beats.narration: But here is the twist. Ten trades prove nothing. This is a question to ask of your own data, not an answer.
I built TradeNotes, my own trading journal, so I'm biased. It lets you tag trades and split your results by tag.
So the habit was never in the results. It was in what happened just before the trade. Every trade still carries risk of loss. A tag only shows where to look.

body.cta: Pick one tag and log it on your next twenty trades. Not financial advice.

promise.sub: The pattern is not in the wins or losses.
